stock.title: Stock
stock.introFull: Stock by warehouse and SKU. Quarantine and transit stock is counted but never sellable; expired lots are never sellable.
stock.introSellable: Sellable stock you can promise to customers, by warehouse.
stock.emptyAlert: Nothing needs attention for these filters.
stock.alertsUnavailable: Reorder alerts are unavailable right now.
stock.reorderHint: Sellable stock across all sellable warehouses is at or below the reorder point.
stock.truncated: Showing the first {n} rows. Narrow the filters to see the rest.

detail.empty: No stock for this SKU in the selected warehouses.
detail.viewMovements: View this SKU in the stock ledger

movements.title: Stock ledger
movements.appendOnly: The ledger is read-only and append-only. Mistakes are corrected with a new movement (an adjustment or a reversal), never by editing or deleting one.

receipts.title: Goods receipts
receipts.intro: Supplier deliveries. A draft moves no stock until it is posted.

receiptForm.title: New goods receipt
receiptForm.intro: Enter the delivery as it appears on the supplier documents. You can review it before posting.
receiptForm.nothingToReceive: No active warehouse or product is available to you.
receiptForm.notSellableWarehouse: This is a {kind} warehouse: goods received here are counted but cannot be sold until they are transferred to a sellable warehouse.
receiptForm.linesHint: One line per lot. Use NO-LOT for products that are not lot-tracked.

issue.EXPIRY_REQUIRED: This product is expiry-tracked: enter the expiry date.
issue.EXPIRED_NEEDS_QUARANTINE: This lot has already expired. Expired goods can only be received into a quarantine warehouse.

receiptForm.submitHint: Saving creates a draft. Stock changes only when you post it.

receipt.draftNotice: Draft: no stock has moved yet. Check the lines, then post.
receipt.cancelledNotice: This receipt was cancelled; it moved no stock.
receipt.expiredWarning: Expired lots ({lots}) cannot be posted into a sellable warehouse. Create the receipt for a quarantine warehouse instead.
receipt.postHint: Posting adds every line to the ledger in one step. It cannot be edited afterwards; corrections are adjustments.
receipt.viewMovements: View the ledger movements of this receipt

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.intro: Stock moving between warehouses. Shipped stock is in transit: it is in neither warehouse until received.
transfers.inTransitBanner: In transit now: {n}. Tap to show only those.
transfers.linesUnavailable: Line details are unavailable right now.
transfers.inTransitNote: In transit: left the source, not yet received at the destination. Not sellable.
transfers.shipHint: {units} units leave {from} now and are in transit until received.
transfers.shippedOk: Shipped. The stock is now in transit.
transfers.releaseNeeded: Receiving this transfer releases quarantined stock and needs the quarantine release permission. Ask your inventory manager.

transferForm.title: New transfer
transferForm.intro: Choose where the stock leaves from, then where it goes and which lots.
transferForm.pickSourceFirst: Choose the source warehouse to see its available lots.
transferForm.notSellableDestination: The destination is a {kind} warehouse: stock there is counted but cannot be sold.
transferForm.noStock: This warehouse has no available stock to transfer.
transferForm.submitHint: Saving creates a draft. Stock moves when the transfer is shipped.
transferForm.quarantineOnly: This is a quarantine warehouse. Its stock can only go to another quarantine warehouse; releasing it needs the quarantine release permission. Ask your inventory manager.
transferForm.releaseWarning: This releases quarantined stock: once received at {warehouse} it can be sold. Only release stock that has passed its quality check.

adjustmentForm.title: Adjust stock
adjustmentForm.intro: Correct the stock of one lot, with a reason. The adjustment is a new ledger movement; nothing is edited.
adjustmentForm.limitNone: Your adjustments post immediately; no approval is needed.
adjustmentForm.limit: Up to {n} units per product and warehouse per day (Cairo time) post immediately. Beyond that, the adjustment waits for approval.
adjustmentForm.pickWarehouseFirst: Choose the warehouse to see its lots.
adjustmentForm.noLots: No lots are recorded in this warehouse. Stock arrives through a goods receipt or a transfer.

outcome.pending_approval: Over your daily limit: sent for approval. The stock changes only when it is approved.
outcome.approved: Approved and posted. The stock is updated.
outcome.rejected: This adjustment was rejected; the stock did not change.
outcome.cancelled: This adjustment request was cancelled; the stock did not change.

adjustmentForm.replayed: This adjustment had already been submitted, so it was not applied again.

errors.INSUFFICIENT_STOCK: Not enough available stock for that. Reserved units cannot be moved or removed.
errors.EXPIRED_LOT: That lot has expired. Expired goods can only be received into a quarantine warehouse.
errors.LOT_EXPIRY_MISMATCH: That lot number is already recorded with a different expiry date. Check the supplier documents.
errors.WAREHOUSE_NOT_SELLABLE: Stock in a quarantine or transit warehouse cannot be reserved or sold.
errors.SAME_WAREHOUSE: The source and destination must be different warehouses.
